notes.title: Election Tycoon Leaderboard Challenge
notes.notes:
We’re excited to introduce leaderboards to Election Tycoon! Whether you’re running as Trump, Harris, or an Independent candidate, your top scores will now be saved. The leaderboard score is calculated based on your electoral votes and general vote percentage. For example, if you win 500 electoral votes and capture 55.3% of the votes in US, your score would be 500.553. It’s time to see who can truly dominate the race!

Jump in, make your mark, and climb the leaderboards to prove you’re the ultimate strategist!
